title: Tunes Buddy Bolden played
summary: Barnes cannot name Bolden's unnamed tunes; Bolden was passing out when he arrived.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Before a tape runs out, what were some of the other tunes Buddy Bowling played?
Well, I couldn't think of all of them because it didn't have no name, you know? It didn't have no name.
I thought maybe you knew some of the different parts in him or something that he would have.
And he was, he was but going out when I come here, you see? He was passing.
